title: Design System: Tien Huynh — Issued Credential

display.purpose: The holder's name on the hero document only; uppercase, given name in engrave.

numeral.purpose: Lead count-up figure on the red field; secondary figures clamp(3.5rem, 8vw, 7rem).

headline.purpose: Uppercase section divisions, revealed with a clip wipe and followed by a microtext rule.

title.purpose: Register, annex and work entry titles; featured entries clamp(1.4rem, 2.6vw, 2.1rem) at width 118%.

label.purpose: Mono uppercase labels on every data field, captions and ledger captions.

mrz.purpose: Machine-readable zone strips; size computed from container width so each line spans it.

shadows.name: sheet-lift
shadows.purpose: Hero document lifting off the security paper.

shadows.name: document-frame
shadows.value: inset 0 0 0 6px var(--paper-3), inset 0 0 0 7px color-mix(in srgb, var(--engrave) 18%, transparent)
shadows.purpose: Engraved inner frame on the hero document.

shadows.name: stamp-drop
shadows.purpose: Filter shadow on perforated certificate stamps.

shadows.name: ink-pool
shadows.purpose: Under the stamp button; 0 4px 10px -8px when pressed.

shadows.name: chat-seal-ring
shadows.purpose: Floating chat seal: paper gap and outer seal ring.

shadows.name: uv-glow
shadows.purpose: Seals under the UV lamp only.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default for state transitions and reveals (--ease-out).

motion.name: seal-stamp
motion.value: spring stiffness 420, damping 22; from scale 1.6, rotate tilt-14deg, blur 3px to scale 1, tilt, opacity 0.92
motion.purpose: Seals stamp down once on entering the viewport.

motion.name: stamp-drop-in
motion.value: spring stiffness 380, damping 24; from scale 1.25, y -20px; stagger 0.07s
motion.purpose: Certificate stamps landing on the sheet.

motion.name: arch-rise
motion.value: scroll-linked spring stiffness 90, damping 22; scale 0.35 to 1, y 60% to 0 as the field top travels from viewport bottom to 35%
motion.purpose: Half-disc arch rising at each colour field boundary.

motion.name: hero-disc
motion.value: scale 0 to 1, 1.2s ease-out; then scroll-linked x 0 to 35%, scale 1 to 1.25 over 700px
motion.purpose: Vermilion disc behind the hero document rolling out on scroll.

motion.name: division-reveal
motion.value: clip-path inset(0 0 100% 0) to inset(0 0 -10% 0), 0.8s ease-out; microrule scaleX 0 to 1, 1.2s
motion.purpose: Section title wipe and microtext rule ruling in.

motion.name: scene-scroll
motion.value: scroll-linked spring stiffness 120, damping 28, mass 0.4 over a 320vh pin
motion.purpose: Seal dot travelling the record and lighting lines.

motion.name: count-up
motion.value: once on view; item rise y 40px, 0.8s ease-out, stagger 0.08s
motion.purpose: Giant figures on the red field.

motion.name: foil-sweep
motion.purpose: Resting hologram sweep over the portrait; pointer-tracked sheen on top.

motion.name: rosette-turn
motion.purpose: Slow rotation of the hero guilloche rosette.

motion.name: uv-spread
motion.value: 0.9s cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1), clip-path circle from the switch

motion.name: cover-morph
motion.purpose: Work plate morphing into the project overview cover.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: opacity-only reveals; rosette, foil sweep, stamp and scene transitions disabled
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion path required for every motion.

components.name: Colour Field with Arch
components.description: Full-bleed section in one tone that redefines the ink tokens; a half disc of its colour rises from its top edge.

narrative.overview:
The site is a security-printed identity document issued to its holder. Every region is printed matter: engraved guilloche rosettes and bands, embedded fibres, microtext rules, dashed field rules, a machine-readable zone in mono, and round rubber-stamp seals that verify a claim and open its proof. Type is set like a document's data page: expanded grotesk caps for names and divisions, a mono for serials, dates, field labels and the MRZ.

The document is not one sheet. Whole sections are full-bleed colour fields (paper, sand, red, teal, sage, ink) that own their width; each field announces itself with a half-disc arch of its own colour rising out of the field above as the visitor scrolls in. A red disc rises behind the hero document, a pinned scene runs a seal down the holder's record, and the red field carries giant count-up figures. Density is that of a filled form: ruled rows, generous margins, no card grid.

Dark mode is the same document under a UV lamp, never an inverted palette: a violet-black ground, fibres and seals that fluoresce, and a UV-only print in the hero that only appears under the lamp. The theme switch reveals the lit document as a circle spreading from the switch.
keyCharacteristics: Security paper ground with fixed engraved bands and fibres behind everything.
Full-bleed colour fields, each redefining the ink tokens locally, joined by rising half-disc arches.
Ruled registers (2px ink top rule, dashed engrave row rules) instead of cards.
Vermilion ink seals as the verification and action mark; they stamp down on arrival.
Holographic foil on the portrait only, tracking the pointer.
MRZ strips in mono spanning the full width of the hero document and footer.

rules.name: The Seal Is the Hot Mark Rule
rules.body: Vermilion marks what is verified, active or the primary action. It never becomes a section ground except on the red field, and on the red field the seal token inverts to ink (and to mint under UV) so the stamp still contrasts.

rules.name: The Field Owns Its Ink Rule
rules.body: A colour field sets the whole token family locally. Components never hard-code colours for a field; they read `--ink`, `--engrave`, `--seal` and the field supplies them.

rules.name: The Same Document Under UV Rule
rules.body: Dark mode re-lights the same document: same layout, same components, fluorescent equivalents of every token. Nothing is added or removed except the UV-only print.

rules.name: The Width Is Rank Rule
rules.body: Higher rank is set wider: 125% for name, numerals and divisions, 105–120% for titles and buttons, 85% for labels.

rules.name: The Mono Is Machine Rule
rules.body: Martian Mono carries only what a machine would print: serials, dates, counts in meta lines, labels, the MRZ, the UV toggle. Prose is never mono.

rules.name: The Ruled Row Rule
rules.body: Lists of evidence are registers: a 2px ink rule on top, dashed engrave rules between rows, hover tints the row with 4–5% seal. Never a card grid, except certificates, which are perforated stamps on a sheet.

rules.name: The Paper Stack Rule
rules.body: Only physical sheets (the hero document, record sheet, stamps, photo) cast shadows. Controls and rows are flat.

rules.name: The Circle Is Official Rule
rules.body: Round forms are reserved for seals, arches and the hero disc: anything circular reads as an authority mark.

dos: **Do** put every claim on a field: mono uppercase label above, value beneath, dashed engrave rule under it.
**Do** let colour fields set the token family; build components only from `--paper`, `--ink`, `--ink-2`, `--engrave`, `--seal`.
**Do** open new sections with a division: uppercase width-125% title, a short note, and a microtext rule that rules in from the left.
**Do** use a seal (stamping down on arrival) wherever something is verified or opens its proof.
**Do** provide the UV equivalent for every new colour, and a reduced-motion path (opacity only) for every scroll or stamp motion.
**Do** ease with cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) for state and reveal transitions.
donts: **Don't** use vermilion as a decorative fill or section ground outside the red field and the hero disc.
**Don't** put gold foil anywhere but the portrait hologram and the record sheet's fold.
**Don't** lay evidence out as a card grid; use ruled registers, or stamps on a sheet for certificates.
**Don't** cast shadows from controls or rows, and never use hard offset shadows.
**Don't** set prose in mono, or labels in the grotesk.
**Don't** hard-code hex colours in components; the overview pages' own accent hexes are drift, not precedent.
